explanation: Fast horizontal motion (60 m/s) triggers many substeps per step (68-72). Gravity appears to be integrated with the wrong time scale when substepping is active: vy gains ~4 m/s per 1/30 s step instead of g*dt=0.667 m/s (6x too large), so kinetic + potential energy grows each step with no controller work, eventually exceeding the 10%+5J bound. Small dt removes the excess substepping and the failure disappears.
